mentions.name: Co-Wiki
mentions.description: Co-Wiki is a wiki-based warm storage layer designed to sit between LLM context windows and vector databases, built for human-agent co-authorship. The complete, documented, open design aims to solve endless chat threads, RAG chunking failures, and the lack of second brain infrastructure, and is published for others to implement.
mentions.problem: Solves chat hell, RAG chunking failures, and the missing second brain infrastructure.
mentions.source_excerpt: This morning published a design manifesto for the Co-Wiki — a wiki-based warm storage layer that sits between LLM context windows and vector DBs, designed for human-agent co-authorship.
